title: Nonzero binary columns
statement: Let $\ell$ and $n$ be nonnegative integers with $n\le 2^\ell-1$. For each $j\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, define its column to be the nonzero binary vector of length $\ell$ assigned to the index $j$ by the standard bijection between the indices $0,\ldots,2^\ell-2$ and nonzero binary vectors of length $\ell$.
